Spend in the way of Allah, do not throw yourselves into destruction, and do good, for Allah loves the doers of good.
What is spent of good goes to parents, relatives, orphans, the needy and the traveler, and Allah knows whatever good is done.
Believers are told to spend from what Allah provided before a Day with no exchange, friendship or intercession.
Spending in Allah's way is like a grain that grows seven spikes of a hundred grains each, and Allah multiplies reward for whom He wills.
Allah knows whatever is spent or vowed, and the wrongdoers have no helpers.
No one attains the good reward until they spend from what they love, and Allah knows whatever is spent.
Those who withhold what Allah gave them of His bounty should not think it good for them; it will encircle their necks on the Day of Resurrection.
Allah dislikes those who are stingy and conceal His bounty, or spend to be seen without believing, with Satan as companion; believing and spending would have cost them nothing.
Believers are told to establish prayer and spend from what they are given, secretly and publicly, before a Day with no exchange and no friendships.
Give relatives, the poor and travelers their right without wasteful spending; speak gently if you must turn the needy away, and be neither tight-fisted nor fully open-handed.
Allah extends and restricts provision for His servants, and whatever they spend He will replace, for He is the best of providers.
Worldly life is amusement and diversion; Allah does not ask believers for their wealth, yet some withhold when invited to spend in His cause, withholding only from themselves.
Believe and spend from what Allah made you successors over; those who spent and fought before the conquest rank higher, and a goodly loan to Allah is multiplied.
Spend from Allah's provision before death comes and one begs for a brief delay to give charity, for Allah delays no soul when its time has come.
Fear Allah as far as able, listen, obey and spend; whoever is saved from his soul's stinginess succeeds, and Allah multiplies a goodly loan and forgives.
By night, day and the creation of male and female, efforts differ: whoever gives and fears Allah is eased toward ease, the stingy denier toward difficulty, his wealth no help.
